title: Airlines
description: Every airline in the dataset, including ones that have ceased, with enough data to lay out the world-level circle pack without loading any fleet. Rules JSON Schema can't check: IDs are unique; successor_id references an airline in this file; every airline with fleet_count > 0 has a fleets/{id}.json file whose aircraft match fleet_count and family_counts.

airline.title: Airline
airline.description: One airline. Fleet figures describe the fleet as of manifest.data_as_of.

id.description: Stable pipeline-assigned ID. Use this in URLs and references, never the ICAO or IATA code.

name.description: Display name, e.g. from Wikidata or the cleaned operator name.

wikidata_qid.description: Matching Wikidata item, or null if the airline couldn't be matched.

icao.description: ICAO designator the airline used, or null if it has none or it is unknown.

iata.description: IATA designator the airline used, or null if it has none or it is unknown.

country.description: Country the airline is based in, or null if unknown.

region.description: Region the airline appears under in the circle pack, or null if unknown. The app groups null regions under 'Unknown'.

founded.description: When the airline was founded or started operating, or null if unknown.

ceased.description: When the airline stopped operating, or null if it is still operating or the date is unknown.

successor_id.description: Airline that took over when this one ceased or merged, or null if there is none or it is unknown.

logo.description: Airline logo, or null if none is available.

fleet_count.description: Number of aircraft in the fleet as of manifest.data_as_of. 0 for airlines with no current fleet, such as ceased airlines.

family_counts.description: Fleet size per type family, used to draw family circles before the fleet file loads. Invariant: the values sum to fleet_count. Families with no aircraft are left out, so an airline with fleet_count 0 has {}. Written in ascending key order.
